We Inspire

We're breaking new ground as the pioneers of research-oriented electrical engineering technologies at KCL. Our passion lies in diving deep into the captivating realm of high voltage circuits, PCB design, motor control, and even crafting potent laser devices! We also run a series of courses that covers the content of a conventional electrical engineering degree, and a set of specialized course.

We Democratize

We're building an open-source community with accessible academic resources and our own electrical engineering curriculum. There's no hierarchy; instead, we embrace a responsibility-driven approach where anyone capable can take charge instantly. Every member has visibility and able to join the decision-making process in all the time, we should implement all merrier suggestions immediately. From each according to his ability, to each according to his need.

We Educate

Unlock the secrets of the electrifying universe with our dual set of courses! Whether you're a beginner seeking a solid foundation in electrical engineering or an aspiring mad scientist yearning to build electromagnetic catapult, lasers, and Tesla coils, we've got you covered with an electrifying curriculum that will spark your curiosity and unleash your inner innovator through weekly sessions!
